wholePhysicalScope: The named five-point cathedral footprint gives the west Plaza Bolívar frontage, long north aisle, and perimeter adjoining the separate Museo Sacro on the south.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the stepped cathedral frontage, tiled nave roofs and clock tower. Near levels refine the belfry, portals and facade mouldings.
limitations: Section and tower heights, nave roof arrangements, window design, current ornament and vertical registration are approximate. The standing exterior combines exact archival imagery with the modern written inventory.
The model covers the cathedral’s envelope, attached sacristy and chapels. The separately mapped Museo Sacro, surrounding plazas, freestanding statues and the interior are separate scopes.
